en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard. The front shows a panoramic view over the historic center of Pécs framed by tree branches, with church towers and a dome rising above old city walls and rooftops; hills and fields appear in the distance. At the bottom of the image there is a Hungarian caption printed in white. The reverse side has a green Hungarian postage stamp, circular postmark, printed address lines, a typed address to Dr. Fábry Lajos in Budapest, and a handwritten Hungarian message.
